name: Firehouse Subs

menuSurfaces.title: Firehouse Subs US menu and linked allergen system

attempts.outcome: Official US site, current menu promotion, and nutritional-information link inspected; the site directs guests to its Nutritionix nutrition/allergen system.
Official-domain nutrition, allergen, ingredient, and PDF surfaces searched; current product announcements and the linked structured allergen tool were found.
The Firehouse-branded Nutritionix special-diets system supplies item-level allergen results across menu products and sizes.
Targeted chain allergen search corroborated the official Nutritionix integration and found no conflicting higher-authority matrix.

notes: All frozen direct allergen positives from the Firehouse-branded Nutritionix system are preserved and unioned across size presentations.
Products added from current official menu announcements remain unavailable where no structured allergen row was captured.
No empty or unlisted field is treated as confirmed allergen absence.

summary: Firehouse Subs is confirmed as a US chain-level record. All 96 frozen Nutritionix rows reconcile once; 70 size/generic-name presentations consolidate into canonical products and 26 remain exact. The current boundary contains 64 unique products including July 2026 additions. The official site links a structured Nutritionix allergen system; direct positives are preserved and unioned across sizes, while newly announced products without captured allergen rows remain unavailable.
proposedChanges: Collapse Small, Medium, and Large rows into one canonical product while preserving the union of direct allergen positives.
Consolidate legacy Macaroni and Cheese into 5-Cheese Mac & Cheese.
Add current menu, salad, soup, kids, and July 2026 Smokin’ Honey products absent from the frozen projection.
Retain linked-vendor authority for Nutritionix allergen evidence and leave uncaptured new-product allergens unavailable.

findings.finding: The frozen catalog represents size variants as separate products, creating extensive equivalent duplicates.
Current official menu/newsroom materials add products not represented in the frozen extract.
Firehouse directly links its structured Nutritionix system for item-level nutrition/allergen handling.

coordinatorNotes: Chain-level scope is intentional because the packet has no location ID.
Size-level allergen rows were consolidated without dropping any positive allergen.
No unsupported allergen-negative or cross-contact safety claim was made.
